name: agentkit-studio
description: Continue local coding tasks in an AgentKit Studio cloud sandbox.

interface.shortDescription: Hand off local tasks and continue them in Studio.
interface.longDescription: Create a temporary Studio cloud sandbox, restore a Git-aware project snapshot, securely inject GitHub CLI authentication, and continue the active task without copying Codex runtime state or SSH keys.
defaultPrompt: Continue this project and task in my AgentKit Studio sandbox.
